_doc: One item value model, shared by the gear advisor (service advice, characterwrapper.cpp ga_*), the random item generator and Fenia's item measure (.config("fight/item_value")). Units are gear-score points. melee/caster: per-profile weight per point of an apply (level/slevel/skill_level_* per +1, beats per -1% skill lag). shared: profile-independent weights; ac weight is ac_base at level 1 falling to 0 at ac_zero_level. flags: [melee, caster] per affect flag (a flag the char can self-cast counts 10%). res: [res, imm, vuln] per damage class (resists do not stack). measure: one roll of the item measure (M) and the slot factors (rolls = level / factor), tier budgets in M. grant_skill: what an item-granted skill is worth to its wearer. A missing key falls back to the compiled default. docs/plans/armor-generator.md.

measure._doc: Read by Fenia .tmp.craft.getMeasure. One roll = +1 damroll, +1 hitroll, +10 hp, +10 mana. rolls = level / factor; jeweler crafts use jeweler_factor. tier_budget is in M (one measure), reference level ref_level. craft_budget_cm: crafted armor (craft/armor generateAffects) per craft tier 1..5 in centi-M (Fenia has no floats). enchant_budget_cm: enchant armor target [rare, epic with creativity or Enki]. repair_cm: repair price in silver per item level at 100% damage, tier 1..5 (legendary..common; hand-made = uncommon) -- tier_budget x 0.7, read by public utils/object repairPrice.
measure._doc_calibration: P7 knobs (model only): stat_floor {level: share} = least share of an item's budget spent on stat_sections; max_affixes_bonus {level: n}. Calibrated on item-dump.py --model reruns vs docs/plans/item-baseline/before.jsonl.

detects._doc: Points per detect affix [melee, caster] (decision 11). From the generator's senses prices. A detect the char can cast itself counts 10% (sage fit).

materials._doc: Points per item material [melee, caster] (decision 12): durability today. Weapon materials still carry their combat side here until the combat-effect model (P3) prices it from the mob census.

extras._doc: Points per extra flag [melee, caster]: noremove, anti_good, bless... From the generator's extra prices (Kit 2026-10-03). anti_good/anti_evil/evil = 0: personalization, not a minus (Kit 2026-10-04).

materials_combat._doc: Combat side of weapon materials in points by level: mobs vulnerable / resistant / immune to the material (protectMaterial). scripts/item-combat-model.py.

flags_by_level._doc: Affect flags in points by level [melee, caster] (one combat frame, Kit 2026-10-04): defense = hp saved per average fight (tier spawn share x measured incoming x rounds x share removed), offense = DPS share. Wins over the flat flags table when the item model is on. scripts/item-combat-model.py.

grant_skill._doc: Item-granted skills (grantskills behavior), priced per character by the gear sage (characterwrapper.cpp ga_grantsValue): PvE + pvp_weight x PvP + QoL per skill, 0 when the wearer already has the skill or its align/ethos refuses the wearer. pvp_weight: share of PvP worth counted (0 for clan Flowers). nature_share: share of fights in nature rooms (forest fighting). active_use: share of the time a granted nuke is actually cast; mana_share: share of the mana pool spent per fight; fight_rounds: rounds per fight by level. crit_*: critical strike bonus per proc and the worth of its blind/stun at the reference proc chance. blink_pvp_share: the most of a duel's damage blink is credited with removing [melee, caster]. nuke_cond, nuke_pvp_share, buff_uptime, pet_round_share: per-skill knobs. fixed: [PvE melee, PvE caster, PvP melee, PvP caster, QoL] per skill, x learned/100. ref_*: the reference player of the char-less base value. docs/plans/grantskills-pricing.md.
